chat.connectingCommunity: You are in. Connecting to the group: messages go out as soon as a member's app is reached.
chat.connectingMembers: You are in. Connecting to the members: messages go out as soon as one of them is reached.
chat.gone: This group is gone from this device.
chat.noFiles: Files are not part of groups yet
chat.nobodyElse: Nobody else is in the group yet

connection.label: Group connection
connection.noWebrtc: Groups can't connect from this app yet
connection.noWebrtcHint: Group links need WebRTC or a native transport (Iroh, HyperDHT), and this app has neither, so no member can be reached from here. Open the group on the web app or on another device to take part.
connection.nobodyElse: Nobody else is in the group yet.
connection.note: Each member is a direct, end-to-end encrypted link from your app to theirs. Group links use WebRTC, and Iroh or HyperDHT with a member whose app has no WebRTC (Ghostly Desktop on Linux). DHT-only delivery is not offered in groups yet. A member who is not reachable gets what they missed from any member who has it when they are back.
connection.offlineHint: This device is offline: no member can be reached until it is back online.

create.communityHint: A link anyone can open, even while you are away: any member lets people in. Up to {{count}} members.
create.hint: You get a link to share: whoever opens it joins. Everyone in the group reads everything sent while they are in it.
create.privateHint: Up to 32 people, from your contacts or your link, which works while your app is open. Everyone connects to everyone.
create.title: New group

event.removed: You were removed from this group

hubs.badgeHint: Passes the group's messages on to the members it is connected to. It sees who talks when, not what is said.

join.admitted: The admin's app answered: getting the group's keys. You are in in a moment.
join.admittedCommunity: A member's app answered: getting the group's keys. You are in in a moment.
join.answered: The admin's app saw you knock and is connecting to you. You are in in a moment.
join.answeredCommunity: A member's app saw you knock and is connecting to you. You are in in a moment.
join.answeredTitleCommunity: A member is letting you in
join.knocked: Waiting for the admin's app to let you in. It happens on its own as soon as their app is open: you can leave this page and come back.
join.knockedCommunity: Waiting for someone in the group to let you in. It happens on its own as soon as any member's app is open: you can leave this page and come back.
join.knocking: Leaving a knock where the admin's app looks for one…
join.knockingCommunity: Leaving a knock where the group's apps look for one…
join.stale: Still no answer. If the group's link was replaced, this one no longer works: ask for the new link.

step.admitted: Let in: getting the group's keys
step.knocked: Knock left for the admin's app

leave.blocked: You are the admin and nobody else in the group is online to take over. Try again when a member is, or make someone the admin first.
leave.blockedCommunity: Nobody in the group is connected right now to take your leave. Try again in a moment.
leave.body: The group and its history go from this device. You will not read what is said after, and to come back someone has to let you in again.
leave.successor: You are the admin: {{name}} becomes the admin when you leave.
leave.title: Leave {{name}}?

link.broken: This link to a group does not work
link.copyFailed: Copy did not work. Select the link and copy it.
link.disableHint: Nobody can join with the link until it is on again
link.enableFailed: Could not turn the link on
link.full: The group is full ({{count}} of {{count}}): nobody gets in through the link until someone leaves.
link.note: Anyone who opens this link joins, without being your contact or saying who they are. They get in while your app is open, up to {{count}} members.
link.noteCommunity: Anyone who opens this link joins, without being anyone's contact or saying who they are. Any member's app lets them in, so it works while you are away; up to {{count}} members. Removing someone does not stop them from opening the link again: the admin makes a new one for that.
link.off: The link is off: nobody can join with it. Turn it on to let anyone who has it in, without being your contact.
link.resetHint: A new link; the current one stops working
link.shareFailed: Sharing did not work. Copy the link instead.
link.title: Group link

member.noSlot: Waiting for a free connection on this device

members.missingHint: Messages of this epoch that nobody could recover
members.needsBothHint: Groups need both apps connected and updated
members.noContacts: Every paired contact is already in, or you have none yet.

readNote: Everyone in the group can read everything sent while they are a member. Someone removed keeps what they already received and cannot read what comes after; someone who joins later cannot read what came before. Messages go directly to each member; whoever was away gets what they missed from any member who has it (the group's last {{count}} messages) when they meet again.
readNoteCommunity: Anyone with the group's link can join, and any member can let people in. Everyone in the group can read everything sent while they are a member; someone removed cannot read what comes after, someone who joins later cannot read what came before. Members who were away get the last {{count}} messages from whoever is there when they return.

remove.body: They won't get the group's new messages.
remove.linkHint: They can still join again with the group's link: a new link keeps them out.
remove.title: Remove {{name}}?

rename.hint: Every member sees the new name. Older apps keep the name they joined with.
rename.label: Group name

share.createdHint: Share its link to bring people in: whoever opens it joins.
share.hint: Whoever opens this link joins the group.
share.title: Share {{name}}
